messages:
maria: Heads up — preflight eval gate just flagged the canary for summarizer v2.3.1 in eu-west.

deploybot: [automated] preflight-eval FAILED for release summarizer@v2.3.1: overall quality delta -2.3% vs baseline. See /deploy/2856 for details.

raj: linking the run: https://internal.eval/runs/4839 — can someone grab a small failing sample?

qa_jordan: pulled a quick sample (n=30). Most failures are on 'policy-questions' prompts — hallucinations / missing specific policy text. Example snippet:
```
input: "What's the return policy for the premium plan?"
expected: contains "30 days"
actual: "contact support for details"
```

sophie: ouch. our gate threshold is 1.5% delta, right?

maria: yep, 1.5% across the full prompt suite. This is 2.3% overall but concentrated in the policy-questions group.

raj: we can do route-level pins/splits. Proposal: keep v2.3.1 for general traffic, pin policy-questions route to v2.2.9. Need ops approval to change routing config during the window.

ops_oncall: ops ok with route-level pin as a mitigation. Will need release note entry and a rollback plan in case pin doesn't stabilize metrics.

qa_jordan: should we bisect? quick local eval on v2.3.1 with alternative quant profile might show whether quantization caused regressions.

maria: go for the quick eval, raj?

raj: starting quick eval (sample=500) with quant-alpha profile, ETA ~6m.

deploybot: [automated] rerun-started: eval-run-4839 by raj

raj: results in —
```
policy-questions: delta -3.0% (n=500)
other-groups: delta +0.2%
```

qa_jordan: that's worse under quant-alpha. I recommend blocking the full rollout.

maria: agreed. Block full rollout. Requesting ops to apply pin for policy-questions route to v2.2.9 and QA to collect failing prompts into an artifact for the model team. @sophie can you open the release exception?

sophie: filed INC-3241: "preflight eval block — policy prompt regression; route pin to v2.2.9; hotfix candidate v2.3.3". Added links to eval run and samples.

ops_oncall: applying route pin now. Will follow with confirmation.

deploybot: [automated] route-pin APPLIED: route=policy-questions -> model=v2.2.9 by ops_oncall (change-id: cp-9812)

maria: thanks — that should mitigate customer impact. Next steps: QA to publish failing prompt set and triage notes; model team to investigate tokenizer/attention changes. Schedule hotfix for tomorrow morning window.

qa_jordan: uploading failing prompt set to eval-suite/blocked-policy-2026-03-21.json and starting triage thread.

raj: adding debug logs, tokenizer diffs, and config snapshots to the ticket.

maria: do we want a global rollback or is route-pin sufficient for now?

ops_oncall: route-pin sufficient at the moment. Global rollback is riskier and will be considered if we see regressions outside the policy route.

maria: perfect. We'll reassess after hotfix test pass. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
